verdict.rationale: The official README states that games export with one click to the major desktop platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows), mobile (Android, iOS), web, and consoles. A community report confirms that desktop distribution packaging is simple. Missing for 10: detail on how console export works (first-party vs. partner porting, SDK/licensing requirements), dedicated export documentation for each platform, and independent hands-on corroboration of mobile and console shipping.
